name: Waygate (location)
summary: The Waygate is a mysterious piece of Titan machinery situated upon the Shaper's Terrace overlooking Un'Goro Crater. Constructed in ancient times alongside the surrounding Titan facilities, the inactive gateway stands as an intriguing relic of primeval arcane engineering.

sections.title: A Dormant Relic of the Makers
sections.body: Perched on the Shaper's Terrace along the sheer eastern cliffs of Un'Goro Crater stands the Waygate. Crafted by the Titans from stone and ancient arcane mechanisms, this device was engineered to channel immense energy into a teleportation portal. However, it currently sits quiet and dormant, untouched for centuries. Explorers and scholars investigating the crater's unique ecosystem view the structure as clear evidence that the Makers shaped this lush basin using advanced, long-forgotten magic.

faq.answer: The Waygate is a Titan-crafted gateway located at the Shaper's Terrace in Un'Goro Crater. It was designed using ancient arcane engineering to form an instantaneous portal.
No, the Waygate is dormant. It has remained inactive for centuries, leaving scholars and adventurers to merely marvel at its silent stone structure and dormant Titan mechanisms.
The Waygate was built by the Titans, the cosmic shapers who used Un'Goro Crater as an ancient testing ground and research site.
The Waygate sits atop the Shaper's Terrace, an elevated Titan structure on the eastern rim overlooking Un'Goro Crater.

angles.text: Mages find the Waygate fascinating for its ancient Titan arcane geometry, showcasing teleportation methods that far predate modern Kirin Tor practices.
As seekers of Titan lore, dwarven explorers are drawn to the Shaper's Terrace to catalog and uncover the secrets of the Makers' stonecraft.
